_meta.description: Heart event #6 for npc_janis: Words Fail

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [The Overlook, sunset. Janis has removed her Council brooch]

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: I sent my resignation to the Council today.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: They said I was throwing away a promising career.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: I had a five-year plan. A trajectory. A purpose.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: Now I can't imagine being anywhere else. And that terrifies me.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: I have been in control of every moment of my life since I was twelve.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: Every word calculated. Every move strategic.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: But you are the one variable I cannot control.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: I had a speech prepared. Twelve sentences. Perfectly structured.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: But standing here, looking at you, I can barely...

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: I am Janis Beaumont. I ALWAYS have the perfect words.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: And right now I can't find a single one that's good enough.

options.text: You don't need perfect words. Just honest ones.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: Well. That's a first. Janis Beaumont, speechless.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: I choose this. I choose Coppervale. I choose you.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: And if that's not eloquent enough, I don't care.
